info.name: Magis Space API
info.description: REST API for finding vacant study rooms. Run the whole collection top to bottom (Collection Runner or newman) with the mock SMS server running (the vacant report sends an SMS through it). Every folder is one controller; the last folder deletes what the run created. It passes on an empty database and on a database that already holds earlier runs. Change baseUrl if the app runs on another port.

item.name: Amenities
item.description: AmenityController. GET list, GET by id, POST create, DELETE by id (the delete requests are in the last folder because the room still uses this amenity).

request.description: Creates an amenity. Input: name (required, up to 50 characters). Output: the amenity. Errors: 409 name already exists, 422 blank name.

exec: pm.test("Amenity returned", function () { var j = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(j.id).to.be.a("number"); pm.expect(j.name).to.eql("Amenity " + pm.collectionVariables.get("run")); });

item.name: Rooms
item.description: RoomController. GET list (optional building filter), GET by id, POST create, DELETE by id (in the last folder).

request.description: Creates a room. Input: name, building, floor (0 or more), capacity (1 or more), optional amenityIds. Output: the room with its amenities. Errors: 404 unknown amenity, 409 same name in the same building, 422 validation.

exec: pm.test("Room has the amenity", function () { var j = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(j.name).to.eql("PM-" + pm.collectionVariables.get("run")); pm.expect(j.amenities.length).to.eql(1); pm.expect(j.amenities[0].id).to.eql(Number(pm.collectionVariables.get("amenityId"))); });

item.name: Availability
item.description: ReportController. A vacant report (occupied false) sends an SMS and saves a Notification for every subscriber of the room.

request.description: Saves a report with reportedAt set to now and verified true. Input: studentId, roomId, occupied. An occupied report sends nothing. Errors: 404 unknown student or room, 422 missing field.

exec: pm.test("Report saved as verified", function () { var j = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(j.occupied).to.be.true; pm.expect(j.verified).to.be.true; pm.expect(j.reportedAt).to.be.a("string"); pm.expect(j.roomId).to.eql(Number(pm.collectionVariables.get("roomId"))); });

request.description: A vacant report. The service sends an SMS through the Retrofit client to the mock Twilio and saves a Notification for each subscriber of the room. See Notifications > List notifications - by student. SMS failures never fail this request.

exec: pm.test("Vacant report saved", function () { var j = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(j.occupied).to.be.false; pm.expect(j.verified).to.be.true; });
pm.test("Error body is JSON with status 404", function () { var j = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(j.status).to.eql(404); pm.expect(j.message).to.be.a("string"); });
pm.test("Error body is JSON with status 404", function () { var j = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(j.status).to.eql(404); pm.expect(j.message).to.be.a("string"); });
pm.test("Error body is JSON with status 422", function () { var j = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(j.status).to.eql(422); pm.expect(j.message).to.be.a("string"); });
pm.test("Error body is JSON with status 400", function () { var j = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(j.status).to.eql(400); pm.expect(j.message).to.be.a("string"); });

pm.test("Newest first and contains the vacant report", function () { var list = pm.response.json(); var ids = list.map(function (a) { return a.id; }); pm.expect(ids).to.include(Number(pm.collectionVariables.get("vacantReportId"))); for (var i = 1; i < list.length; i++) { pm.expect(list[i - 1].reportedAt >= list[i].reportedAt).to.be.true; } });

pm.test("Two reports for this room, vacant one first", function () { var list = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(list.length).to.eql(2); pm.expect(list[0].id).to.eql(Number(pm.collectionVariables.get("vacantReportId"))); pm.expect(list[1].id).to.eql(Number(pm.collectionVariables.get("occupiedReportId"))); });
pm.test("Error body is JSON with status 404", function () { var j = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(j.status).to.eql(404); pm.expect(j.message).to.be.a("string"); });
pm.test("Error body is JSON with status 400", function () { var j = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(j.status).to.eql(400); pm.expect(j.message).to.be.a("string"); });
pm.test("Error body is JSON with status 404", function () { var j = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(j.status).to.eql(404); pm.expect(j.message).to.be.a("string"); });

exec: pm.test("Error body is JSON with status 404", function () { var j = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(j.status).to.eql(404); pm.expect(j.message).to.be.a("string"); });

item.name: Notifications
item.description: NotificationController. Notifications come from vacant reports or from POST /notifications; both send an SMS through the Retrofit client.

item.name: List notifications - by student (created by the vacant report)

request.description: Optional studentId filter, newest first. The subscriber should have one notification from the vacant report above.

exec: pm.collectionVariables.set("vacantNotificationId", (function () { var l = pm.response.json(); return l.length ? l[0].id : null; })());

pm.test("Subscriber was notified that the room is vacant", function () { var list = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(list.length).to.eql(1); pm.expect(list[0].studentId).to.eql(Number(pm.collectionVariables.get("studentId"))); pm.expect(list[0].message).to.include("PM-" + pm.collectionVariables.get("run") + " (Postman) is now vacant as of "); pm.expect(list[0].message).to.match(/ is now vacant as of \d{1,2}:\d{2} (AM|PM)\.$/); });
